versionName: Say whether emails were sent before saying nothing went out
versionDescription: Audit 2026-09-02: the Offer Dispatch consequence line always read NO OFFERS WERE EMAILED, including on 2026-08-31 execution 28570 where all 507 Heinz emails had been delivered and only Write Sent Log failed. Compose Alert now reads the failing node and the message: post-send node -> the emails were already sent, do not re-queue; partial send -> who got it is in the Sent Log; halt -> nothing sent, reason in the error line.
